# The Explicit namespaces Reference

<DoxygenPage version="1.13.2">

TODO: add <code>@brief</code> to <code>@defgroup micro-test-plus-explicit-namespaces</code>

## Description {#details}

In complex projects, the definitions in the <code>micro&#95;test&#95;plus</code> namespace might interfere with application definitions.


:::info
To avoid names clashes, it is recommended to use the comparator functions with explicit namespaces, possibly aliased to shorter names.
:::

However, for those who prefer brevity, it is also possible to declare the namespace <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus</Link></code> at scope level, and use all the definitions directly.
